limits: Historical receipts were inspected; native workloads and comparisons were not rerun.
Context-mode local-file access was blocked by its configured project root; local evidence was successfully read through the permitted native shell.
Upstream READMEs were inspected as source-review evidence, not executed acceptance.
The non-adopted DBHub candidate supplies no evidence references establishing superiority.
open_gaps: No candidate establishes the complete shared acquisition, licensing, identity and historical-eligibility requirement.
DuckDB native evidence covers bundled simulation events; financial availability, amendment and decimal-boundary checks use artificial fixtures.
The referenced SEC attempt failed with HTTP 403 and produced no live source payload or Parquet dataset; later acquisition results mentioned in the packet were not independently inspected.
No retained comparison measures representative data volumes, concurrent writers/readers, latency, recovery or operational cost across storage candidates.
Immutable-file guards, hashes and exact decimals do not establish original historical publication, complete corporate actions or survivorship-free universes.

arms: Candidate storage or compute implementation consuming identical frozen records and enforcing identical availability and integrity rules
overturn_protocol.metric: Require exact decimal and cutoff equivalence, rejection of unknown/conflicting availability and tampered artifacts, preserved immutable outputs, then measure latency, throughput, memory, concurrency and recovery on the same declared workload.

overturn_when: Overturn after an executed candidate comparison using tests/test_financial_data.py and blueprints/us-equities/data/summarize_backtest.py preserves their decimal, cutoff, integrity and replay contracts while closing a demonstrated capacity or recovery gap. Run python3 -m unittest tests.test_financial_data in the pinned research environment with both DuckDB integration tests executed; a skipped or baseline-only run cannot promote a challenger.
why_selected: Select DuckDB for the storage/compute scope. Retained native execution in blueprints/us-equities/data/receipt.json records six bundled LEAN simulation events, three distinct orders and a hashed Parquet output reread by blueprints/us-equities/data/summarize_backtest.py. blueprints/us-equities/research-runtime/receipt.json records a subsequent successful packet/Parquet workflow. Separately, blueprints/us-equities/financial-data/receipt.json records synthetic-fixture exact DECIMAL(38,12) roundtrips and conservative availability checks. These demonstrate a working bounded analytical path; application code supplies provenance and rejection rules. Other adopted storage/compute candidates have source review only, while TOON's native serialization evidence addresses a narrower artifact concern.
